author: Skache; derivative animation/preparation: Prehistoric Animal Museum contributors
title: Anomalocaris 3D Model
modifications: Prehistoric Animal Museum contributors: Compressed textures and geometry and added 28 rigid swimming-flap bones plus two segmented frontal-appendage chains. Authored a varied metachronal flap wave, subtle body drift and frontal-appendage motion as a smooth closed eight-second swimming Idle. Life project: decoded meshopt and quantized attributes where present; deduplicated/welded geometry; simplified to measured triangle budget where necessary; resized embedded images to 512px, JPEG quality82; resampled supplied animation and pruned unused data; preserved source materials, skinning and clip names; serialized ordinary self-contained GLB with no geometry decoder extension.

author: Lukiethewesly13; derivative animation/preparation: Prehistoric Animal Museum contributors
title: Mosasaurus
modifications: Prehistoric Animal Museum contributors: Compressed geometry and animation with high-precision Meshopt and converted embedded PNG textures to lossless WebP for browser delivery. Freeze the reviewed source pose and, when eligible, a source-rig partial mouth-close target before making morph animation deterministic. Operation: bake-and-join. Align length to X, center the visible bounds, and apply habitat grounding. Operation: canonical-transform. Export one traceable, closed-loop, in-place project Idle. Operation: replace-runtime-animation. Authored and validator-checked one closed eight-second marine-tail Idle for the shared museum viewer. Included the human-reviewed source-rig partial mouth relaxation in the same Idle loop. Replaced the source tail morph's sign-reversing S curve with two mirrored, length-preserving single-curvature arc targets. Each stroke now begins at the muscular tail root, increases continuously toward the tip, and returns through a neutral straight pose without folding back on itself; retained the symmetric four-flipper swimming targets. Cleared stale normalized flags after promoting repaired morph and animation accessors to floating point so the runtime GLTF loader receives spec-valid data.
